definition: A nonphysical realm associated with dreams, consciousness, and the anomalous events that followed the Crisis.
An institution dedicated to identifying and training individuals capable of Astral Projection and related phenomena.
The nonphysical form assumed by a person during Astral Projection.
A rupture connecting conventional reality with the Astral. Also commonly called a rift or tear. Unrepaired fissures may develop into Incursion Events.
The practice of separating consciousness from the physical body. Once regarded as occult or pseudoscientific, projection became an accepted phenomenon following the Crisis.
A person capable of deliberate Astral Projection. Trained Travelers investigate and repair Astral disturbances.
The act of imposing stability and consistency upon an Astral environment.
A reward currency used within the PerSpective ecosystem. Contribution Points may be earned through designated activities and exchanged for goods, services, or conventional currency.
The period of widespread reality instability and Incursion Events that profoundly reshaped modern society.
The populated regions surrounding Inner City.
The vault or arch of the sky; the heavens.
That upon which something is established or based.
An underlying condition, structure, or fixed system.
The transitional state of consciousness between wakefulness and sleep.
An event in which Astral phenomena manifest within physical reality. Severity varies considerably.
The central metropolis surrounded by the populated outer districts.
The stabilizing center of an Astral Space. Damage or distortion to a Locus can destabilize the surrounding environment.
The central technology of the former Ministry Paradigm. Its operation profoundly influenced society before the system was disabled.
The event that ended operation of the Minerva system. Thomas Tiresias is generally held responsible.
One of the network facilities formerly used to extend the operational field of the Minerva Device.
The government institution responsible for responding to Astral disturbances and maintaining the structural stability of reality.
The former Ministry responsible for the Minerva system and its supporting infrastructure.
A person who explores dream states or dream worlds.
An augmented-reality headset produced by the Sifting Corporation.
The operating environment used by PerSpective devices.
An Astral environment given sufficient stability and consistency to behave more like conventional reality.
A major technology company responsible for the PerSpective product line and other advanced technologies.
The commonly used term for catastrophic loss of the connection between an Astral Traveler and their physical body.
The connection between an Astral Traveler and their physical body during projection.
Government-provided baseline material support, including housing and essential goods.
